shared_elements: human face/head rendered at the top of a vertical shaft
frontal human figure carved on an upright block
eyes, nose and mouth indicated on the face
justification: Both depict an upright columnar monument bearing a frontal human face near the top of the shaft, and in both the head occupies the upper zone with an undifferentiated body/base below. Beyond that generic scheme they differ greatly: A is densely covered with elaborate interlaced scrollwork, stacked cartouches and small subsidiary faces in a highly ornate, deeply modelled relief, while B is an extremely reduced, almost featureless form with only crudely blocked-out brow, nose and mouth and no surface ornament at all.
